svg.title: Today: an artifact is a path in one checkout
svg.desc: An agent's evidence is written in its worktree's ignored artifacts folder: 1,453 pictures, 249 MiB, across this repository's checkouts, beside 4.4 GiB of scratch data. The sweep moves a finished worktree's folder into the main checkout's artifacts/swept, under a 5 GB cap. The owner's uploads are already stored by content in the main checkout, and card pictures are committed under docs. A thread post that names a worktree's path breaks when the worktree goes: 6 of the 8 worktrees such posts name are gone. Another machine, a clone of main and a consumer's Cargo fetch hold none of the artifacts.

The numbers behind it
· Board: 2,041 posts on 307 tasks; 123 name the artifacts folder: 23 files, 48 task folders.
· The consuming project's documents show 1,340 pictures from its ignored folder; 30 are already missing on this machine.
· A clone of main is a 99 MiB pack: 65.6 MiB the client, 4.9 MiB committed pictures. Artifacts add nothing, being ignored.
· A consumer's Cargo keeps 78 to 87 MiB of Symphony's history and a 379 MiB checkout per pinned commit.
Sizes by du, find and stat, read only; posts by just tasks show --json; history by git cat-file.
